name: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia A
original_name: 光翼戦姫エクスティアＡ
source: The World's peace restored once again after Marina (ExS-TIA) and Riesz (ExS-TIA Chevalier) defeat Garzom. After that, in the spring break, Marina and Riesz go on overseas school trip. However, Souma could not go because he need to attend supplementary class for the bad results in his final test. While Marina and Riesz gone overseas, Jinevra revived as Jinevra Ω seeking for revenge against ExS-TIA and start the invasion again. Souma then ask Azarin, who get ExS-TIA power, to fight together against this new threat as ExS-TIA Magica.
translation: 玛丽娜（ExS-TIA）和里斯（ExS-TIA Chevalier）击败加尔佐姆后，世界再次恢复和平。之后，在春假期间，玛丽娜和里斯去海外修学旅行。然而，相马因期末考试成绩不好而需要参加补习班，因此未能前往。当玛丽娜和里斯出国时，吉内芙拉以吉内芙拉Ω的身份复活，寻求向ExS-TIA复仇并再次开始入侵。相马随后要求获得ExS-TIA力量的阿扎林作为ExS-TIA Magica共同对抗这一新威胁。
